Independent QA: **evidence-incomplete**, with a confirmed code correction required. First verdict from trusted QA task01a11c7c-11db-70b8-ba73-efe3693b003e; historical implementation/capture records remain preserved.

**R1 — protected translation can disappear:** clear both Russian main fields, switch to Spanish and Save. `editTileTranslation` removes the empty variant, so validation succeeds. Independent Edge execution confirms the saved Russian correction disappears from IndexedDB and stays missing after reload. Preserve incomplete existing-variant drafts and reject Save/Duplicate until complete; cover both-empty, language switching and reload. [Reproduction and observed state](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/8e946b230afeacb89b9d8ef6be858634f5473f5b/browser-boundary-result.json).

The full eight-commit/15-file scope, existing review fixes, eleven genuine capture states and exact provenance were independently inspected. Current CI passes; the 69 rerun and 49 retained browser cases reconcile. They do not cover R1. iOS export remains unwaived and blocked by the separately owned issue43 dependency fix. Reconcile the final body’s “QA pending” statement after correction, then return final bindings for reassessment.

[Immutable verdict, complete bindings, pixel observations and evidence identities](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/8e946b230afeacb89b9d8ef6be858634f5473f5b/verdict.json), exact published SHA-256 `cfc4bafb5d4fa8f09c637bacb8e85ff91eeec3e42e564e057f01a7df8011eca7`. Assessed head `1b4d2ebf` against actual master `fabb925c`. No source/body/readiness/draft/Project/merge mutation; native-device checks remain deferred.
